## REQ-RES-HEALTH-001

**Fields of the Health DataSet**

The Payload of a Health DataSetMessage contains the mandatory field Health (DeviceHealthEnumeration as "&lt;name>_&lt;value>": NORMAL_0, FAILURE_1, CHECK_FUNCTION_2, OFF_SPEC_3, MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED_4) and optionally HealthScore (Byte, 0 … 100) and Details (array of DetailObject); a DetailObject contains the mandatory Health (same enumeration) and optionally DiagnosticCode, Location and Description (String each); no other field.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 8.3.2
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.2-4017a916, MG-8.3.2-4b88043e, MG-8.3.2-619204cc, MG-8.3.2-729cc64d, MG-8.3.2-75b94f9a, MG-8.3.2-8e123ade, MG-8.3.2-8f5d5ddc, MG-8.3.2-918d692d, MG-8.3.2-c6d90f6d, MG-8.3.2-d2f6bc0e, MG-8.3.2-ed805854

Notes: Field presence and types per REQ-CMP-025/026; the rows of Table 13 define the enumeration values. HealthScore is independent of Health (MG 8.3.2, e.g. 30 % with NORMAL_0).

## REQ-RES-HEALTH-002

**Health is the status with the highest priority of the Details**

If Details is present, Health equals the Health with the highest priority of all DetailObjects, using the order of priority FAILURE_1 > CHECK_FUNCTION_2 > OFF_SPEC_3 > MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED_4 > NORMAL_0; statuses of lower priority stay listed in Details.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The Health DataSet contains Details.
- Refs: MG 8.3.2, SF-065, SF-096
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.2-025d3ac2, MG-8.3.2-8b8f5239, MG-8.3.2-fbc1880c

> The Health of the asset must reflect the status with the highest priority of all Details.
> — MG 8.3.2

> The order of priority is FAILURE_1 > CHECK_FUNCTION_2 > OFF_SPEC_3 > MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED_4 > NORMAL_0
> — MG 8.3.2

> Statuses with lower priority remain visible in Details, even if they are superimposed by a status with higher priority.
> — MG 8.3.2

Notes: Order of priority per SF-096 (PO decision 2026-10-23, GL-ADR-001 implementation note, GL-ADR-019): invalid signal (FAILURE_1) before temporarily invalid (CHECK_FUNCTION_2), uncertain (OFF_SPEC_3) and valid signal (MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED_4); it replaces the severity order of SF-065 (a) (OFF_SPEC_3 before CHECK_FUNCTION_2).

## REQ-RES-HEALTH-003

**NE107 symbols and colors for the Health states**

An application that displays Health states uses the symbol and color definitions of NAMUR NE107 (Table 13: green, red, orange, yellow, blue).

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application displays Health states.
- Refs: MG 8.3.2
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.2-b75c4616

> The best practice is to combine the five states NORMAL_0, FAILURE_1, CHECK_FUNCTION_2, OFF_SPEC_3 and MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED_4 with the symbol/color definitions made by NAMUR NE107 (Table 13).
> — MG 8.3.2

## REQ-RES-HEALTH-004

**A change of Details triggers a Health publication**

A change of any DetailObject of an asset triggers a publication of the Health of that asset.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 8.3.2
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.2-b2b93a1e

> A change of any DetailObject must trigger publication of the resource Health.
> — MG 8.3.2

Notes: Publication on a change of Health and the 60 s heartbeat are REQ-TOP-017.

## REQ-RES-HEALTH-005

**Get Health carries no Health object**

A Get Health NetworkMessage contains no Health DataSetMessage; its Messages are empty or contain only the helper DataSets PaginationRequest and Locale.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Scope: MG 8.3.11, MG 8.3.12
- Refs: MG 9.1.2, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.2-7e8e4f18

> In combination with the method Get, the payload requires an empty NetworkMessage.
> — MG 9.1.2

> A Health object is not included.
> — MG 9.1.2

## REQ-RES-HEALTH-006

**Get Health is answered with all addressed Health objects**

A Get Health without Source is answered with all available Health information of the application (itself and all subordinate assets), each in its own DataSetMessage of a single NetworkMessage published to Pub/Health; a Get Health with Source is answered with the Health of that asset on Pub/Health/&lt;Source>.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The entity supports Get for Health (REQ-CMP-017).
- Refs: MG 9.1.2, SF-062
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.2-6895efd3, MG-9.1.2-83c997a9

> Via the &lt;Method>/&lt;Resource>[/&lt;Source>] combination Get/Health[/&lt;Source>], the publication of this information to the Pub/Health[/&lt;Source>] topic can be triggered.
> — MG 9.1.2

> A topic such as Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Get/Health must trigger a publication of all available Health information, each in its own DataSetMessage added to a single NetworkMessage and published to the topic Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Pub/Health.
> — MG 9.1.2

Notes: Pagination of large answers is REQ-PAG-005, ReplyTo is REQ-MSG-015.

## REQ-RES-HEALTH-007

**Pub Health carries Health objects and optionally Pagination**

A Pub Health NetworkMessage contains Health DataSetMessages and optionally the helper DataSet Pagination; it contains no PaginationRequest and no DataSetMessage of another resource.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 9.1.2, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.2-02856c38

> In combination with the method Pub, the payload contains DataSetMessages of type Health – none in the answer to a Get without content (Resources Without Content) – and optional Pagination (8.3.11.2 Pagination).
> — MG 9.1.2

Notes: A Locale is only meaningful in a Get and ignored in other methods (REQ-LOC-003).
